justification: Campbelltown Part 3 PageLoss on page 41. Reader input: a chunk with >= 10 same-text same-spot twin spans (a PDF printing each line twice, black + white) goes to sol as JPEG page pictures plus de-doubled text, and to DeepSeek as de-doubled text; other chunks unchanged. Coverage check: running headers/footers (on >= 30% of pages, >= 3) and section-number headings are not scored as rule lines. Review re-read with DeepSeek (no live write): no page left out, the 17 pages the live chapter has no rules for are covered, 0 doubled-letter rules.
